scope: Audit-only same-detected-crest nonregression and paired-render metadata consistency; never anatomical sheet certification
design_sequence: Designed after reading Codex007's public aggregate outcomes; frozen before accessing unavailable per-site records. Exploratory on those sites, not an independent validation or external preregistration.

point_audit.tie_tolerance_origin: The existing Codex protocol treats changes up to 0.25 native voxel as ties; this is a scoring convention, not a physical uncertainty estimate.

pair_audit.manifest_success_meaning: Only declared-metadata self-consistency. The validator does not prove file contents, surface identity, UV area accuracy or anatomical registration.

optional_interval_audit.rule: Keep a proposed displacement strictly inside the worst-case midpoint boundaries between the initially nearest detected crest and both adjacent detected crests, using explicitly supplied location-error bounds.
optional_interval_audit.status: Conditional algebra only. No empirical crest-location uncertainty bound is available for the public 0813 aggregates; this formulation has no measured anatomical guarantee.

current_public_evidence: Only aggregate result.json is published. Per-site point-metrics.json, peak profiles and full displacement records are not present in the source branch. A new measured acceptance rate cannot be obtained from the aggregate.
required_next_validation: Apply the unchanged audit to saved per-site records, then evaluate a prospective fresh public surface with independently reviewed sheet correspondence before changing production geometry.
